project_name: Ven y Ve 360 - Grupos Frontales (Front Groups)

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight leading-none font-['Spectral']
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500

layout_strategy.anti_nested_cards: Strict prohibition of card-in-card stacking. Use high-contrast split panels with 1px hairline borders (`border-slate-200`), direct table views, and subtle background alternating rows.
layout_strategy.bento_grid_mode: Mode B (High-Density Dashboard with Left-to-Right Flow)
layout_strategy.mobile_first: Stack navigation & controls vertically on mobile screens (< 768px). Sidebar tree collapses into full-width accordion/drawer on mobile.
layout_strategy.padding_rules: Generous spacing philosophy: p-6 to p-8 inside primary control boxes. 12px min padding on interactive items to avoid text clipping.

recursive_tree_viewer.concept: Pastora -> Líderes -> Ramas -> Subramas sin límite fijo de profundidad
recursive_tree_viewer.dual_role_handling: A single canonical Persona can be displayed both as a member of an upper group AND as leader/owner of their own sub-branch with a 'Rol Dual' visual badge.
recursive_tree_viewer.navigation: Interactive node expand/collapse with active breadcrumbs trail showing branch ancestral chain.

work_inbox_and_delegation.concept: Bandeja de trabajo que desciende por el árbol y métricas que ascienden
features: Direct delegation to child sub-branches or specific canonical Personas
Ascending metric aggregates (personas alcanzadas, consolidaciones activas, retención semanal)

consolidation_authority_and_audit.concept: Consolidación conserva autoridad para revisar rotación semanal y confirmar/modificar asignaciones
consolidation_authority_and_audit.audit_requirements: Every manual rotation modification opens an audit dialog requiring mandatory reason (motivo) and records timestamp, editor ID, and prior assignment history.

cell_origin_vs_frontal_group.concept: Célula de Origen y Grupo Frontal Responsable son datos separados
cell_origin_vs_frontal_group.configurable_link: Configurable relation picker showing Cell ID vs Frontal Group ID with explicit override options.

invasion_creation.integration: Opens Mapa 360 modal/drawer preset with sector geometry selection, reusing existing GeoMaps component ecosystem without duplicating domains.

pastoral_care_isolation.security_rule: Frontal Group membership NEVER grants access to Pastoral Care (Cuidado Pastoral) notes or confidential vault records.
pastoral_care_isolation.ui_indicator: Discreet padlock badge indicating Pastoral Care Vault is isolated under restricted access policy.

component_structure.FrontGroupsPage.js: Main layout container with sticky header, high-level metrics header, breadcrumbs, search, and dual-panel view.
component_structure.FrontGroupTreeNav.js: Recursive tree sidebar with depth indicators, search filter, active state indicator, and 'Crear Rama' action.
component_structure.FrontGroupDetailPanel.js: Structured workspace view featuring tabbed sections: (1) Resumen y Métricas Ascendentes, (2) Bandeja de Trabajo y Delegación, (3) Rotación Semanal y Consolidación, (4) Equipo y Rol Dual, (5) Vinculación Células.
component_structure.FrontGroupDialog.js: Dialog for creating/editing Frontal Groups & recursive sub-branches with parent_id binding.
component_structure.FrontGroupAuditModal.js: Audit confirmation dialog for Consolidación assignment overrides with mandatory motivo field.
component_structure.FrontGroupInvasionDialog.js: Modal triggering 'Crear invasión' using Mapa 360 sector & target link.

testing_and_data_attributes.mandatory_data_testid: Every interactive element, input, filter, badge, button, and dynamic list item MUST have explicit data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve existing API contracts and add additive attributes for parent_group_id, child_branches, rotation_history, audit_logs, and origin_cell_id.
Do NOT hard delete any group or assignment; set status='inactive' or soft-archive to maintain audit history.
Ensure button text is EXACTLY 'Crear invasión' as mandated by prompt.
In the leader panel, build an intuitive work tray ('Bandeja de trabajo') showing active consolidations down the branch hierarchy.
Include empty state screens with contextual guidance for new branches with zero active groups.
Strictly enforce that Pastoral Care notes are never accessible from Front Group UI components.
